notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast The Prismatic Piper for {0} due to Rakdos.
description:
Cast The Prismatic Piper from the command zone by paying {0}.
Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Prismatic Piper, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to have The Prismatic Piper return to command zone.
Repeat.
